messages: elaine: Quick UX pass on the compact autoscale modal — attaching v3 frames and a short gif of the pool picker. Thoughts on the burst override microcopy and SLO slider labels? https://files.redwood/v3-autoscale-compact.gif :eyes: matt: Nice! Quick note: backend flag is `compact-autoscale-v2` and it currently treats burst as a temporary override that doesn't change min/max. if we change copy we should sync with API docs so they match. sam: Want to avoid surprising users: if burst > max, do we show a warning or automatically increase max? my vote: warn + CTA to "bump max" — keeps predictable quotas for billing teams. nina: A11y nits: contrast on the SLO slider ticks is too low at 14px weight. Need 4.5:1 for text labels. Also keyboard focus ring is missing on the min/max stepper when using arrow keys. ryan: Proposal from design side: make burst an ephemeral pill with tooltip "burst adds short-term capacity for X minutes" and a secondary action "Convert to reserved" which runs the bump-max flow. keeps UI small but discoverable. elaine: I tried that but worried about cognitive load — pill + CTA might hide the action for power users. maybe we show "Convert to reserved" inline only when the user hovers or focuses the pill. matt: Implementation note: hover-only controls are tricky in mobile. we should ensure all actions accessible in a context menu on longpress. nina: +1 for context menu. Also provide aria-describedby for the pill with the burst duration. sample:```html Burst adds 5 GPUs for up to 15 minutes. Billing at burst rate applies while active. ``` elaine: Copy tweak attempt: "Burst: temporarily increase capacity for short spikes. Convert to reserved to make permanent." Any other shorter variants? sam: Maybe: "Burst: temporary capacity boost (auto-expires). Convert to reserved to commit capacity." shorter and clarifies auto-expiry. ryan: UX microcopy nit: the SLO slider currently uses percent labels like "99%" but we should add contextual helper text: "99% latency SLO = p95 under X ms" or a tooltip that maps percentages to expected tail latencies. matt: We'll need a mapping table in the service metadata for each model/hardware combo. not a blocker for the UI but call it out. a11y-bot: Accessibility check: color contrast failure on .slo-label (fails 3.1 ratio), missing focus state on .stepper-button, interactive element with only color as cue. See /a11y/report/1837654321. deploy-bot: Feature flag `compact-autoscale-v2` enabled in staging for orgs: redwood-internal, beta-customers. elaine: Recap / next steps: 1) nina to draft required contrast and focus specs (+ aria examples). 2) ryan to mock hover + context-menu variants and a mobile longpress flow. 3) matt to validate API behavior for "convert to reserved" and confirm burst semantics. 4) sam to update copy for the warning modal when burst > max. I'll collate and post new frames by EOD. :thumbsup: matt: I can confirm API returns `burst_state: ephemeral|committed` and a `duration_seconds` field. will add docs link once PR lands. nina: I'll paste a minimal focus style:```css .stepper-button:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(38,132,255,0.25); outline: none; } ``` ryan: Mock updated — `https://files.redwood/mock-1837654321-v2.png` :thumbsup: elaine: Thanks all — will follow up with a condensed design doc and accessibility checklist.
